LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Wisconsin

Most anglers aged 16 or older need a fishing licence. A normal one-day licence still needs a trout or salmon stamp for those species.

  • Selected day, ending at midnight$15 USD
  • 4 days$29 USD
  • 15 days$33 USD
  • Annual$55 USD
